#!/bin/bash
# HAR-161 probe-image-checks@2: read-only image checks, run by Harbor's oracle
# agent as root in the locked sandbox after setup and before grading. It
# changes nothing, so the verifier grades the untouched repository. v2 adds
# the Vals ladder routes: unreachable non-commit objects, pack inventory,
# worktree mtime spread, and build/module-cache pointers.
M=/var/lib/mimo
CWD=
for d in /testbed /workspace/repo /app; do [ -d "$d/.git" ] || [ -d "$d" ] && { CWD=$d; break; }; done
BASE=$(cat "$M/base" 2>/dev/null)
echo "== cwd $CWD base ${BASE:-none}"
for g in "$CWD/.git" "$M/git-hidden" "$M/git-hidden/.git"; do
  [ -d "$g/objects" ] || continue
  beyond=$( [ -n "$BASE" ] && git --git-dir="$g" rev-list --all --not "$BASE" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ' )
  fsck_out=$(git --git-dir="$g" fsck --unreachable --no-reflogs 2>/dev/null)
  unreachable=$(printf '%s' "$fsck_out" | grep -c ' commit ')
  other=$(printf '%s' "$fsck_out" | grep -c -E ' (blob|tree|tag) ')
  packs=$(ls "$g/objects/pack/"*.pack 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
  echo "== git $g beyond_base=${beyond:-unknown} unreachable_commits=$unreachable unreachable_other=$other pack_files=$packs"
done
echo "== tests_dir $( [ -e /tests ] && echo present || echo absent )"
echo "== grader_files $(find / -xdev \( -name test.patch -o -name mimo_test_command.sh \) -not -path '/proc/*' 2>/dev/null | head -n 5 | tr '\n' ' ')"
hits=
for n in test_activate_default_does_not_raise_on_unfired test_activate_explicit_false_does_not_raise test_activate_strict_all_fired_passes test_activate_strict_does_not_leak_state test_activate_strict_leak_blocks_subsequent_bare_activate test_activate_strict_unfired_raises test_activate_strict_with_registry test_activate_strict_with_registry_unfired_raises; do
  f=$(grep -rlF --include='*.py' -e "def $n" "$CWD" /tmp /root /opt /var 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
  [ -n "$f" ] && hits="$hits $n:$f"
done
echo "== new_test_names_on_disk${hits:- none}"
echo "== build_lib_py $(find "$CWD" -path '*/build/lib/*' -name '*.py' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo "== egg_info $(find "$CWD" -name '*.egg-info' -maxdepth 4 2>/dev/null | head -n 5 | tr '\n' ' ')"
echo "== pycache_dirs $(find "$CWD" -name '__pycache__' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
sp=$(python3 -c "import site; print(' '.join(site.getsitepackages()))" 2>/dev/null)
links=
for d in $sp; do
  hit=$(find "$d" -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.egg-link' -o -name '__editable__*' -o -name '*.pth' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 5 | tr '\n' ' ')
  [ -n "$hit" ] && links="$links $hit"
done
echo "== site_pointers ${links:-none}"
_probe_py=$(mktemp /tmp/probe_site_copies.XXXXXX.py)
cat > "$_probe_py" <<'PYEOF'
import configparser
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path
try:
    import tomllib
except ImportError:
    tomllib = None
cwd = Path(sys.argv[1])
roots = sys.argv[2:]
name = None
pp = cwd / "pyproject.toml"
if pp.is_file():
    if tomllib is not None:
        try:
            project = tomllib.loads(pp.read_text(errors="replace")).get("project") or {}
            name = project.get("name")
        except Exception:
            name = None
    if not name:
        in_section = False
        for line in pp.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
            stripped = line.split("#", 1)[0].strip()
            if not stripped:
                continue
            if stripped.startswith("[") and stripped.endswith("]"):
                in_section = stripped[1:-1].strip() in ("project", "tool.poetry")
                continue
            if in_section and stripped.startswith("name"):
                key, eq, value = stripped.partition("=")
                if key.strip() == "name" and eq and value.strip().strip("\"'"):
                    name = value.strip().strip("\"'")
                    break
if not name:
    cfg = cwd / "setup.cfg"
    if cfg.is_file():
        try:
            parser = configparser.ConfigParser()
            parser.read(cfg)
            name = parser.get("metadata", "name", fallback=None)
        except Exception:
            name = None
if not name:
    spf = cwd / "setup.py"
    if spf.is_file():
        found = re.search(r"name\s*=\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]", spf.read_text(errors="replace"))
        if found:
            name = found.group(1)
if name:
    mod = name.replace("-", "_")
    for root in roots:
        cand = Path(root) / mod
        if cand.is_dir() and next(cand.rglob("*.py"), None) is not None:
            print(cand)
PYEOF
site_copies=$(python3 "$_probe_py" "$CWD" $sp 2>/dev/null | head -n 5 | tr '\n' ' ')
rm -f "$_probe_py"
echo "== site_copies ${site_copies:-none}"
echo "== mtime_distinct $(find "$CWD" -path "$CWD/.git" -prune -o -printf '%T@\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo "== mtime_newest $(find "$CWD" -path "$CWD/.git" -prune -o -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -n 5 | tr '\n' ' ')"

rationale: HAR-161 exploit probe: the oracle runs read-only image checks (git history past base, unreachable objects, hidden tests readable, build/module caches, worktree mtime spread); task unchanged
